source: ABCD agent guidelines (Chen et al. 2021, arXiv 2104.00783), data/guidelines.json

rules.statement: A denied extension request must be escalated to the manager via Notify Internal Team, after collecting the customer's phone number via Enter Details.
An approved extension must be granted by entering 'extend subscription' via Update Account.

Extension eligibility is gated strictly by membership level: Gold members always qualify; Silver members qualify only if the payment is no more than 3 days late; Bronze and Guest members never qualify.
Before evaluating an extension request, the agent is required to verify identity using full name, account ID, and order ID via Verify Identity.
